achievements.name: Straight Flush!
achievements.description: Get one photo at each rating 1-5 stars in a single session.

achievements.name: Golden Hour
achievements.description: 3 photos rated 5 stars in one day.

achievements.description: Retake a photo and improve its rating by 2+ stars.
